images.filename: The Big Bush Turkey in Kyogle, NSW.jpg
images.caption:
The Big Turkey is a statue of a turkey at the southern end of Kyogle in New South Wales.
The name Kyogle is adapted from the Bundjalung word ‘kaiou-gal’ meaning ‘egg of the bush turkey or bustard’ or “native companion” which is a fast long-legged running bird.
